entries.reason: carried over the filters of UIImagePickerController: images, videos and their combinations; a filter of live photos matches nothing of iOS 6
entries.effect: the class is there, and imagesFilter, videosFilter, livePhotosFilter and anyFilterMatchingSubfilters: make the filters; the picker shows the media types a filter names
entries.source: the header of PhotosUI of iOS 16.4 for the contract, and UIImagePickerController of iOS 6.1.3 on an iPad 2 and an iPhone 4S for what the release can do; tests/backports/device/phpicker.m

entries.reason: the configuration is kept; iOS 6's picker chooses one item, so a selection limit above one is not honoured
